background: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a hand painted 2D side-scrolling minecart platform game. Reference is art direction ONLY. Generate a landscape 16:9 BACKGROUND layer, no hero, no cart, no apples, no HUD, NO foreground playable rails or platforms. A lush ancient mine cavern opening into a misty turquoise gorge: enormous organically curved rock arches interwoven with tree roots, distant hanging bridges, small warm amber windows, thin waterfalls falling into fog. Layered low contrast desaturated teal shapes in the distance, muted warm brown stone in middle distance. Leave central horizontal gameplay band y=35%-85% open with soft atmospheric depth; do not place large high contrast objects there. Highest detail around top cavern edge and distant architecture, nothing resembling rectangular tiled blocks. Painterly brushwork and charming animated-film game art matching reference, no heavy outlines. World must be orthographic side view, no floor perspective. Left and right edges should have matching subdued teal cavern atmosphere so it can scroll seamlessly. No typography.
rock: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game terrain material texture, full frame entirely filled with warm slate brown and muted violet natural rock face. Hand painted painterly stylized animation background quality matching supplied reference rocks. Large irregular interlocking cracked stone masses, chipped angular facets, warm ochre highlights from upper left, deep plum crevices, subtle weathered brush texture, restrained detail. Occasional tiny moss ochre-green in cracks. NOT brickwork, NOT rows, NOT cobblestones, NOT a photo. Front-on vertical rock cliff texture, no perspective. Even lighting and detail across frame, tileable edges, no central focal point. No scene, sky, rails, floor, text, objects, borders. This will be mapped to organically shaped hanging stone terrain polygons under minecart rails.
